tasks.goal: Build a single-page web app that lets a user enter recipe ingredients with quantities and unit costs, then displays the total cost and cost-per-serving live as values change.
Build a small HTTP API for tracking daily habits, supporting creating habits, logging completions by date, and retrieving a per-habit completion streak.
Build a command-line expense-splitting application that lets a group add shared expenses and computes who owes whom to settle balances evenly.
